description: All tickers consumed by hicp_fixings.py. Single source of truth — the Python module reads tickers directly from this file.

f_series.description: EUR HICPxT F-series calendar-month fixings. n = calendar month (1=Jan…12=Dec). Bloomberg PX_LAST = implied YoY %. Covers the 12-month cycle starting ~1 year ahead of today.

t_series.description: EUR HICPxT T-series calendar-month fixings. Covers the following 12-month cycle. Level reconstruction uses F-series reconstructed levels as the base.
